bite_combo.note: chomp left, chomp right, MEGA chomp: the front rears up for 12 frames (frames 33-44 of 66, the tell), then the whole body tips down from the hips like an animal drinking and bites at ground level. Exaggerated on purpose (owner: big by default, tune after). tools/jaw/make_combo.py.
bite_combo.note_coelomoves: coelophysis, utahraptor, velociraptor, gallimimus: the deinonychus clip moved onto its rig with tools/gait/transfer_clips.py --floor-feet --pin-toes (same timing and events)

hop_back.note: 0.46 s: crouch, backward leap, landing squash; in place, the game moves the creature back during it. tools/jaw/make_hop_back.py (deinonychus first).
hop_back.note_compsognathus: compsognathus: tools/gait/make_leap.py hop_back, 0.458 s, IK-planted toes on the ground frames, jaw hisses open 10 deg
hop_back.note_coelomoves: coelophysis, utahraptor, velociraptor, gallimimus: the deinonychus clip moved onto its rig with tools/gait/transfer_clips.py --floor-feet --pin-toes (same timing and events)

strafe_left.note: sidestep loop for every species, body keeps facing; tools/gait/make_gait.py <species>.json walk --as strafe_left --travel 1,0,0

leap_back.note: long backward leap, 0.79 s, wings fully flared; the game sets the distance (~5 m)
leap_back.note_compsognathus: compsognathus: tools/gait/make_leap.py leap_back, 0.667 s, deeper crouch, high tuck, nose-up landing
leap_back.note_coelomoves: coelophysis, utahraptor, velociraptor, gallimimus: the deinonychus clip moved onto its rig with tools/gait/transfer_clips.py --floor-feet --pin-toes (same timing and events)

pounce.note: ambush pounce, 0.96 s: crouch, long high forward leap nose-down, wings fully flared; the game sets the distance (owner: larger leaps, ~8-10 m from cover)
pounce.note_compsognathus: compsognathus: tools/gait/make_leap.py pounce, 0.75 s, jaws wide (28 deg) in the air, snapping shut on hit_frac 0.7, arms thrown forward
pounce.note_coelomoves: coelophysis, utahraptor, velociraptor: the deinonychus clip moved onto its rig with tools/gait/transfer_clips.py --floor-feet --pin-toes (same timing and events)
pounce.note_smilodon: smilodon: tools/gait/make_cat_moves.py pounce, 1.0 s: launch from the crouch, forelegs reaching, both forepaws slam down on the prey and the sabres stab at hit_frac 0.7; a landed pounce turns into the pin (pin_stab)
pounce.note_tarbosaurus: tarbosaurus: make_rex_moves.py --tarbo pounce, 1.0 s: the burst out of the stalk, one long low bound (both feet off 0.2-0.65, the game carries the arc), jaws thrust ahead and slammed shut on 0.7; a landed burst is an attack_heavy hit, so it pins (pin_foot)

walk_back.note: backing up: the species' own walk time-reversed (tools/reverse_clip.py), so its natural speed is the walk's; play when velocity is against facing
walk_back.note_compsognathus: compsognathus: its own backpedal loop (make_gait.py compsognathus.json strafe --as walk_back --travel 0,1,0), 0.625 s, natural_speeds.compsognathus.walk_back

dodge_left.note: explosive sideways dodge to the left, ~0.42 s: crouch, push off, body banks, wings flared, lands facing the target; in place, the game moves the creature (tools/jaw/make_hop_back.py --side left)
dodge_left.note_compsognathus: compsognathus: tools/gait/make_leap.py dodge_left, 0.417 s, banks into the jump
dodge_left.note_coelomoves: coelophysis, utahraptor, velociraptor, gallimimus: the deinonychus clip moved onto its rig with tools/gait/transfer_clips.py --floor-feet --pin-toes (same timing and events)

dodge_right.note: explosive sideways dodge to the right, ~0.42 s: crouch, push off, body banks, wings flared, lands facing the target; in place, the game moves the creature (tools/jaw/make_hop_back.py --side right)
dodge_right.note_compsognathus: compsognathus: tools/gait/make_leap.py dodge_right, 0.417 s, banks into the jump
dodge_right.note_coelomoves: coelophysis, utahraptor, velociraptor, gallimimus: the deinonychus clip moved onto its rig with tools/gait/transfer_clips.py --floor-feet --pin-toes (same timing and events)

kick.note: herbivore defence: weight forward, both hind legs snap back and up (hit at 0.45), plant; tools/jaw/make_charge_kick.py
kick.note_tarbosaurus: tarbosaurus: the tail whip in the kick slot (make_rex_moves.py --tarbo kick: the rex tail whip retimed so the crack lands on 0.45); hit from Tail4-7

idle_cold.note: survivor state idle, loops in place of idle when cold: hunched, arms hugged, shivering. tools/make_state_idles.py (same length and fps as idle)

idle_heat.note: survivor state idle, loops in place of idle when hot: fanning the face, other hand on the hip, chin up

idle_tired.note: survivor state idle, loops in place of idle when tired: slumped shoulders, head low, slow sway

idle_exhausted.note: survivor state idle, loops in place of idle when exhausted: bent over, hands on knees, heavy breathing

charge.note: charge loop, stride-matched like run. Herbivores: the run with the head dropped low, horns/frill first (make_charge_kick.py). Deinonychus: its own low sprint (tools/gait deinonychus.json clip charge, body near horizontal, wings swept back), natural ground speed 6.6 m/s = 1.49x its run
charge.note_coelomoves: coelophysis, utahraptor, velociraptor, gallimimus: the deinonychus clip moved onto its rig with tools/gait/transfer_clips.py --floor-feet --pin-toes (same timing and events)

toss.note: woolly rhino horn toss, 1.0 s: starts in the charge's head-low pose and hooks the horn up through the target at 0.3; played by TacticalBrain on a charge impact (the hit is the impact, the clip is cosmetic). tools/gait/woolly_rhino/clips.py

pin_stab.note: smilodon (SP-SMILODON, tools/gait/make_cat_moves.py): 2.4 s held over pinned prey under both forepaws; the head rears with the jaws wide, then the sabres drive down at 0.38 and again at 0.74 (TacticalBrain pin, x pin_mult each, hit from the Head bone)

grab_bite.note: SP-ALLOSAURUS: the hands clamp at 0.3 (TacticalBrain.landed pins the prey), bites at 0.55 and 0.8 (tools/gait/make_allo_moves.py)

smilodon._note: SP-SMILODON: walk/run from tools/bake_clip_speeds.py --dry-run; stalk, strafes and walk_back = make_gait stride / cycle x height_meters / source height (0.3/1.917, 0.3/1.25 mesh units/s x 2.0/0.5684)

tarbosaurus._note: SP-TARBOSAURUS: walk/run from tools/bake_clip_speeds.py --dry-run; stalk = make_gait stride / cycle (1.6 / 2.2 rig m/s) x 6.8 / 8; strafes and walk_back reuse the walk plan

allosaurus._note: SP-ALLOSAURUS: make_gait stride / clip length x height_meters / source height (0.455), not a Godot bake; tuned so the run (5.9 m/s) and walk (2.6 m/s) sit at the stats' 5.2 / 2.6 m/s
